BiblicalUsage: Telassar was a region of Assyria where the children of Eden dwelt. The king of Assyria asks, Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Telassar is named in a boast that failed, and the gods of the nations could not deliver.
